lines.en: The blocks misalign under my feet

lines.zh: 我穿过一片破损的地形
lines.en: I move through broken terrain
The textures thrash across my body

lines.zh: 我走得像一格一格地跳
lines.en: I move as if skipping block by block

lines.zh: 地上的草变成了别的颜色
lines.en: The grass under me turns another color
I come through the seam
The edge of this chunk is soft
Every step leaves noise behind
I follow the ruined boundary
Light bends wrong on me

lines.zh: 我在两个坐标之间移动
lines.en: I move between two coordinates
I do not walk well, but I walk fast

lines.zh: 我停在这个坏掉的区块里
lines.en: I rest inside this broken chunk

lines.zh: 我的形状没有完全加载
lines.en: My shape has not fully loaded
Every block here is trembling
I wait for you to find this place

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色一会儿一变
lines.en: My colors change every moment

lines.zh: 这个区块本来不该是这样
lines.en: This chunk was not supposed to look like this
I need do nothing

lines.zh: 你听见那种嗡嗡声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear that humming
I am stuck at one and a half blocks
The ground here is like water
I am waiting for you to read the words
Every broken place belongs to me

lines.zh: 这一带的地图没有名字
lines.en: This stretch of map has no name
I have been arranged here a long while
You found the corrupted chunk

lines.zh: 找我，就得在坏的地方找
lines.en: To find me, look where things are broken

lines.zh: 我的脸贴在你的纹理上
lines.en: My face is pressed against your texture
Are your eyes starting to hurt

lines.zh: 我看起来不太对，我知道
lines.en: I look wrong, I know
You cannot count my faces
Do not stare at my edges
My outline is still loading

lines.zh: 你刚才眨眼时我换了位置
lines.en: I shifted while you blinked
The rules are different here

lines.zh: 你在的地方是好的，我这边是坏的
lines.en: Your side is intact, mine is broken

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，咔了一下
lines.en: I turn my head, and it clicks
Look at me, my pixels are falling

lines.zh: 我就站在你世界的一条缝里
lines.en: I stand in a seam of your world

lines.zh: 你的影子在这里分成两半
lines.en: Your shadow splits in two here

lines.zh: 这是一块不该存在的区域
lines.en: This is an area that should not exist
I want you to stay and study me
I have been at these coordinates all along
You cannot count how many faces I have.
My name is a string of garbled symbols
A segment of my data fell out
I shiver and the noise increases

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我的一部分
lines.en: That scattered part of me
I snap back to these coordinates
The edge of the wound is uneven

lines.zh: 我还在这里，只是变形了
lines.en: I am still here, only warped

lines.zh: 你打到的不是全部的我
lines.en: You did not strike all of me
My outline went chaotic briefly
I sorted myself back together

lines.zh: 这一下我记得，虽然会忘
lines.en: I will remember this, though I may forget
Everything here is broken

lines.zh: 你给的东西进来也会坏
lines.en: Whatever you bring in breaks too

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，我需要坐标
lines.en: I need no food, I need coordinates
Set it down, it will warp
Your hand reached into the corrupt chunk

lines.zh: 这一点东西补不了什么
lines.en: This will not patch anything

lines.zh: 你带的都是完好的东西
lines.en: You bring only intact things
I take nothing, I only want you to look

lines.zh: 它在这里已经开始腐烂
lines.en: It is already rotting in here
Take it away, do not foul this place
You hit the edge of the corrupt chunk

lines.zh: 你的坐标和我的重合了
lines.en: Your coordinates overlapped mine
I scatter, then gather again
The blocks in you are trembling too
Touch me and your view will glitch

lines.zh: 这一下我传到了你另一边
lines.en: That moved me to your other side
My hands are not quite a shape
Two blocks overlap beneath your feet

lines.zh: 我们之间没有正确的距离
lines.en: There is no correct distance between us

lines.zh: 你退开了，空间也跟着退
lines.en: You pulled back, and the space pulled with you
There is more than one broken place

lines.zh: 另一个我，也在一串乱码里
lines.en: Another me is inside another garbled string

lines.zh: 两个错误放在一起会更错
lines.en: Two errors together make a bigger one
Kin like us need not come close

lines.zh: 我在这里只等坐标重合
lines.en: I only wait here for coordinates to overlap

lines.zh: 一起站着，区块会崩得更快
lines.en: Standing together, the chunk collapses faster

lines.zh: 我听见别处也有同样的嗡嗡声
lines.en: I hear the same hum from somewhere else
We do not pair, we overlap

lines.zh: 另一个我看着另一个方向
lines.en: The other one looks the other way

lines.zh: 这不算伴，只是同一类错误
lines.en: Not a mate, just the same kind of error

lines.zh: 我伸手，抓到了一段数据
lines.en: I reach and grasp a strand of data

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里变形了
lines.en: It warps in my hand

lines.zh: 捡起来之后它不太一样了
lines.en: It looks different once picked up
I have no need of solid things
Its texture came apart first
I set it among the blocks

lines.zh: 掉进来的东西都归这个区块
lines.en: Whatever falls in belongs to the chunk
I try to hold it steady, and cannot
It has no weight here with me
Picked it up, and I cannot restore it

lines.zh: 你也在这片坏的区块里
lines.en: You are in the corrupt chunk too
I have your coordinates
Your outline is already trembling

lines.zh: 我看清你了，虽然不太清楚
lines.en: I see you, though not quite clearly

lines.zh: 从这一格开始，你被标记了
lines.en: From this block, you are marked
This chunk is starting to remember you

lines.zh: 你站的地方出现了一道缝
lines.en: A seam opens where you stand
My sight is wrong, but sufficient
I have read your name

lines.zh: 你往这边看的时候，我就来了
lines.en: I came when you looked this way

lines.zh: 这片错误里只有你一个活物
lines.en: You are the only living thing in this error

lines.zh: 我沿着区块的边界靠近
lines.en: I approach along the chunk boundary

lines.zh: 我不用走路也能到你身边
lines.en: I can reach you without walking
This beginning makes no sound

lines.zh: 你被写进了这一块地形
lines.en: You have been written into this terrain

lines.zh: 这里的一切都缺了一块
lines.en: Everything here is missing a piece
I follow your coordinates

lines.zh: 你身边的方块开始错位
lines.en: The blocks near you start to slip

lines.zh: 我在你视野的边缘卡住
lines.en: I snag on the edge of your vision

lines.zh: 你每走一步，地图就错一点
lines.en: Each step you take errors the map further

lines.zh: 我不需要速度，我需要位置
lines.en: I need no speed, I need position

lines.zh: 你的影子在这里有两个
lines.en: Here your shadow comes in twos

lines.zh: 我靠得太近，你会看不清
lines.en: Too close, and you will lose focus

lines.zh: 这个区块正在被我吃掉
lines.en: This chunk is being eaten by me

lines.zh: 你回头看，就会看见乱码
lines.en: Look back and you will see garbled shapes

lines.zh: 我一直在同一片坏地方等你
lines.en: I have waited in the same broken place
The terrain passes through me
You walked in, so I need not chase
The hum grew louder, that is me
Your shadow is splitting

lines.zh: 我站的地方已经不算地面
lines.en: Where I stand no longer counts as ground

lines.zh: 你越靠近，世界越不完整
lines.en: The closer you come, the less whole the world

lines.zh: 我的手离你的视野很近
lines.en: My hand is very near your view

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，你就分不清
lines.en: Soon you will not be able to tell
I have surrounded this patch
You are inside the error now

lines.zh: 我伸手，穿过了你的轮廓
lines.en: I reach and pass through your outline
That leaves you glitching briefly
My hand shatters against you
The impact made the blocks shiver
I have no weight, only position

lines.zh: 你的视野被一段乱码盖住
lines.en: A garbled patch covers your view

lines.zh: 这一下不太确定有没有打到
lines.en: I am not sure that hit landed
You now carry one more error
I come close, our textures overlap

lines.zh: 我从腐坏的区块里伸出手。
lines.en: I reach out from the corrupted chunk.
I shattered once in front of you
The fragments gather back onto me
That grab came with static
Your ears will ring for a while
I passed through you and turned back

lines.zh: 你还站在原来的坐标上
lines.en: You are still standing at the same coordinate
This chunk has just broken
I come out of that seam

lines.zh: 这里的方块先抖，然后是我
lines.en: The blocks shudder first, then me

lines.zh: 有人在坏掉的地方找我
lines.en: Someone is looking for me in the broken place
Find me in the corrupted chunks
My first frame came out wrong
I seep out of the terrain

lines.zh: 这一块本来不该生成我
lines.en: This chunk was not meant to spawn me

lines.zh: 嗡嗡声从很低的地方开始
lines.en: The hum starts somewhere low

lines.zh: 我出现时，草的颜色变了
lines.en: When I appeared, the grass changed color
I stand on the edge of a single block

lines.zh: 半径内的方块都错开了
lines.en: Every block in range slipped out of place
These coordinates begin repeating

lines.zh: 我的名字没有人念得出来
lines.en: No one can pronounce my name

lines.zh: 我慢慢地从错误里长出来
lines.en: I grow slowly out of the error
A layer of grain appears in the air
I have been here a long time

lines.zh: 你听见刚才那一声了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that sound just now
Broken places draw me
This patch is mine now

lines.zh: 火把我的颜色烧成了别的
lines.en: Fire burned my color into something else

lines.zh: 我从地形里掉出来，卡住了
lines.en: I fell out of the terrain and got stuck

lines.zh: 水把我冲散成一堆像素
lines.en: Water washes me into loose pixels

lines.zh: 爆炸让这一整块地形崩了
lines.en: The blast collapsed this whole patch of terrain

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过了我，留下一个洞
lines.en: Something flying left a hole in me

lines.zh: 这股力把我的纹理抹平
lines.en: That force smoothed out my texture

lines.zh: 我越来越淡，快加载不出来了
lines.en: I grow fainter, nearly failing to load

lines.zh: 雷光让我整块区块闪了一下
lines.en: Lightning flashed the whole chunk
In the void there is not even a chunk
